text: There are courses of 6 grades for 3 levels available namely preliminary level ,intermediate level and senior level. Preliminary level includes grade 1, grade 2 and grade 3 affording Comprehensive , Oral and listening courses. Intermediate level includes grade 4 and grade 5 affording Comprehensive ,Oral ,listening and Reading courses. Senior level includes grade 6 affording Comprehensive, Oral, Listening, Audio-visual, and Newspaper reading courses. There are two tests in every semester. The general score is made up of the score of mid-term examination ,final examination and comprehensive evaluation which account for 30%,40%amd 30% separately. In addition, mid-term examination paper and final examination paper are to be designed in hundred-mark system.
